name: *abc* conjecture
informal: For every positive real number `ε`, there exist only finitely many triples `(a, b, c)` of coprime positive integers, with `a + b = c`, such that `c > rad(abc)^(1+ε)`
informal_en: For every positive real number `ε`, there exist only finitely many triples `(a, b, c)` of coprime positive integers, with `a + b = c`, such that `c > rad(abc)^(1+ε)`
